sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalCustomers
FROM sales.Customers

SELECT COUNT(*) AS DiscontinuedProducts
FROM catalog.Products
WHERE IsDiscontinued = 1

SELECT c.Country, COUNT(*) AS Customers
FROM sales.Customers AS c
GROUP BY c.Country

SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrdersPlaced
FROM sales.Orders
WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2023

SELECT DATEPART(MONTH, o.OrderDate) AS OrderMonth, COUNT(*) AS Orders
FROM sales.Orders AS o
WHERE YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025
GROUP BY DATEPART(MONTH, o.OrderDate)
ORDER BY OrderMonth ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrdersPlaced
FROM sales.Orders
WHERE OrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()) - 1, 0)
  AND OrderDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NewCustomers
FROM sales.Customers
WHERE YEAR(CreatedAt) = 2025

SELECT CAST(SUM(l.LineTotal) AS decimal(14, 2)) AS TotalRevenue
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025

SELECT YEAR(o.OrderDate) AS OrderYear, SUM(l.LineTotal) AS Revenue
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY YEAR(o.OrderDate)
ORDER BY OrderYear ASC

SELECT TOP (10) c.CustomerId, c.CompanyName, COALESCE(c.FirstName, '') + ' ' + COALESCE(c.LastName, '') AS CustomerName, SUM(l.LineTotal) AS Revenue
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
JOIN sales.Customers AS c ON c.CustomerId = o.CustomerId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.CompanyName, c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY Revenue DESC

SELECT c.Segment, AVG(t.OrderRevenue) AS AverageOrderValue
FROM (SELECT o.CustomerId, SUM(l.LineTotal) AS OrderRevenue
      FROM sales.Orders AS o
      JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
      WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
      GROUP BY o.CustomerId) AS t
JOIN sales.Customers AS c ON c.CustomerId = t.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.Segment

SELECT TOP (5) p.Sku, p.Name, SUM(ol.Quantity) AS UnitsSold
FROM catalog.Products AS p
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS ol ON ol.ProductId = p.ProductId
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025
GROUP BY p.Sku, p.Name
ORDER BY UnitsSold DESC

SELECT ed.EmployeeId, ed.FirstName, ed.LastName, COUNT(o.OrderId) AS OrdersHandled
FROM hr.EmployeeDirectory AS ed
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.SalesRepId = ed.EmployeeId
WHERE ed.DepartmentId = (SELECT DepartmentId FROM hr.Departments WHERE Name = 'Sales')
  AND YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025
GROUP BY ed.EmployeeId, ed.FirstName, ed.LastName
ORDER BY OrdersHandled DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT TOP (1) s.Name, COUNT(p.ProductId) AS ProductCount
FROM catalog.Suppliers AS s
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.SupplierId = s.SupplierId
GROUP BY s.Name
ORDER BY ProductCount DESC

SELECT o.ShipCountry, COUNT(*) AS CancelledOrders
FROM sales.Orders AS o
WHERE o.Status = 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY o.ShipCountry

SELECT d.Name, COUNT(ed.EmployeeId) AS Employees
FROM hr.EmployeeDirectory AS ed
JOIN hr.Departments AS d ON d.DepartmentId = ed.DepartmentId
WHERE ed.TerminationDate IS NULL
GROUP BY d.Name
ORDER BY Employees DESC

SELECT ed.FirstName, ed.LastName, ed.JobTitle
FROM hr.EmployeeDirectory AS ed
JOIN hr.EmployeeDirectory AS m ON ed.ManagerId = m.EmployeeId
WHERE m.JobTitle = 'VP of Sales' AND ed.TerminationDate IS NULL

SELECT tc.Name AS Category, SUM(l.LineTotal) AS Revenue
FROM catalog.Products AS p
JOIN catalog.Categories AS c ON c.CategoryId = p.CategoryId
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.ProductId = p.ProductId
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = l.OrderId
JOIN catalog.Categories AS tc ON tc.CategoryId = COALESCE(c.ParentCategoryId, c.CategoryId)
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025
GROUP BY tc.Name
ORDER BY Revenue DESC

SELECT w.Name AS Warehouse, COUNT(*) AS ProductsBelowReorderLevel
FROM inventory.Warehouses AS w
JOIN inventory.Stock AS s ON s.WarehouseId = w.WarehouseId
WHERE s.QuantityOnHand < s.ReorderLevel
GROUP BY w.Name

SELECT w.Name, SUM(s.QuantityOnHand * p.UnitCost) AS TotalStockValue
FROM inventory.Stock AS s
JOIN inventory.Warehouses AS w ON w.WarehouseId = s.WarehouseId
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = s.ProductId
GROUP BY w.Name

SELECT SUM(s.QuantityOnHand) AS DiscontinuedUnitsInStock
FROM catalog.Products AS p
JOIN inventory.Stock AS s ON s.ProductId = p.ProductId
WHERE p.IsDiscontinued = 1
  AND s.QuantityOnHand > 0

SELECT SUM(p.Amount) AS TotalRefunds
FROM sales.Payments AS p
WHERE p.IsRefund = 1
  AND YEAR(p.PaidAt) = 2025

SELECT p.Method, COUNT(*) AS Payments
FROM sales.Payments AS p
WHERE p.IsRefund = 0
GROUP BY p.Method

SELECT COUNT(o.OrderId) AS UnpaidOrders
FROM sales.Orders AS o
LEFT JOIN sales.Payments AS p ON p.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status = 'Delivered' AND p.OrderId IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS Customers
FROM sales.Customers AS c
WHERE CustomerId NOT IN (SELECT CustomerId FROM sales.Orders)

SELECT c.Segment, 
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS decimal(5,2)) * 100.0 / COUNT(o.OrderId) AS CancellationRate
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN sales.Customers AS c ON c.CustomerId = o.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.Segment
